literal_diagnostic.method: Fixed file-level surface overlap: lowercase ASCII tokens matching [a-z_][a-z0-9_]*, distinct sets, no stopword list, no stemming or per-repo tuning. Count intersection of question tokens with each full positive source file and the already designated wrong file. A strict lexical distractor has more distinct question tokens than every eligible positive file.
literal_diagnostic.purpose: Supplemental concrete literal-surface distractor witnesses among already independently rejected wrong files. Does not assert that BM25, CodeCortex or any retriever ranks the negative higher; length normalization and term rarity are not modeled.
